boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten documented campus settings for quiet work, collaborative sessions, computer-based tasks, and supported academic work.

cards.title: Library Lower-Level Quiet Study Space
cards.subtitle: St. Catherine University Library, lower level
cards.notes: Bring headphones for any audio and use this designated quiet area for focused solo reading, writing, or problem sets.
cards.short_summary: A library lower level specifically designated for quiet individual study.
cards.evidence_claim: St. Kate’s Library designates its lower level as a quiet study space and prohibits conversation, online meetings, and cell-phone use there.
cards.source_title: Library Use Policy | St. Catherine University Library and Archives
cards.access_notes: Library quiet-study rules apply; headphones or earbuds are required for audio, and the library cannot guarantee silence.

cards.title: Study Room 125
cards.subtitle: St. Catherine University Library
cards.notes: Reserve the room through LibCal, then use the stability-ball seating when a more active seated work setup helps.
cards.short_summary: A reservable library study room documented as having stability-ball seating.
cards.evidence_claim: The Library lists Study Room 125 as a location with stability balls for seating; student study rooms are reservable through LibCal.
cards.source_title: Accessibility | St. Catherine University Library and Archives
cards.access_notes: Current St. Kate’s students reserve study rooms online or on the tablets outside rooms; reservations are within library open hours.

cards.title: Study Room 126
cards.subtitle: St. Catherine University Library
cards.notes: Book a slot before meeting up, and use the stability-ball seating for a change from standard desk chairs.
cards.short_summary: A second reservable library room with documented stability-ball seating.
cards.evidence_claim: The Library identifies Study Room 126 as having stability balls for seating and provides online or in-library room reservation options.
cards.source_title: Accessibility | St. Catherine University Library and Archives
cards.access_notes: Study rooms are for academic work and reserved for St. Kate’s students outside class time; book within library open hours.

cards.title: Library Main Floor
cards.subtitle: St. Catherine University Library, Coeur de Catherine
cards.notes: Choose a table here for work that allows normal conversation, and keep calls or online meetings from disturbing nearby users.
cards.short_summary: The Library’s conversational-level study floor for independent or collaborative work.
cards.evidence_claim: The Library permits normal conversational levels throughout its main floor and describes the library as a place to study and work independently or collaboratively.
cards.source_title: Library Use Policy | St. Catherine University Library and Archives
cards.access_notes: Normal conversational levels are permitted; use headphones for audio and limit calls or online meetings with external speakers.

cards.title: Dew Drop Area
cards.subtitle: Library main floor, Coeur de Catherine
cards.notes: Set up at the main-floor Dew Drop tables when you want a library-based work area with a documented assistive magnifier nearby.
cards.short_summary: A named Library main-floor area with tables and a documented TOPAZ magnifier.
cards.evidence_claim: The Library’s reservable-space policy identifies the Dew Drop area as a main-floor table area, and the accessibility page locates a TOPAZ Magnifier there.
cards.source_title: Library Reservable Space Policies | St. Catherine University Library and Archives
cards.access_notes: Use is subject to library rules; the area may have limited event availability so as not to disturb student use.

cards.title: The Pulse Booths
cards.subtitle: The Pulse, Coeur de Catherine
cards.notes: Bring a device and use the booth data ports for a class-project session in this student-programming and gathering space.
cards.short_summary: Booth seating in The Pulse with data ports for class-project work.
cards.evidence_claim: St. Kate’s states that students can work on class projects using the data ports in The Pulse booths.
cards.source_title: Coeur de Catherine | St. Catherine University
cards.access_notes: The Pulse is a shared venue for student programming and gatherings; plan for an active, social setting rather than a quiet room.

cards.title: Tutoring and Learning Center
cards.subtitle: Coeur de Catherine, Room 21
cards.notes: Book a tutoring appointment or arrange an onsite learning-strategy session when you want structured support alongside your coursework.
cards.short_summary: CDC 21 is the home of St. Kate’s Writing and Reading and Math and Science tutoring centers.
cards.evidence_claim: The Tutoring and Learning Center is in Coeur de Catherine Room 21, provides academic support across the university, and offers its services at no charge.
cards.source_title: Tutoring and Learning Center | St. Catherine University
cards.access_notes: Book or cancel tutoring appointments through the university’s appointment link; onsite and online learning-specialist appointments are available Monday through Friday.

cards.title: Access and Success Study Spaces
cards.subtitle: Library 66, lower level of the Library
cards.notes: If you are a student parent, ask Access and Success about the study rooms, computers, printer, and adjacent playroom in Library 66.
cards.short_summary: A Library 66 study setting equipped for student parents.
cards.evidence_claim: The Library use policy says Access and Success has student-parent rooms in Library 66 with computers, a printer, study spaces, and an adjacent playroom.
cards.source_title: Library Use Policy | St. Catherine University Library and Archives
cards.access_notes: This space is described for student parents; contact Access and Success for details before relying on it.

cards.title: St. Mary Hall Computer Labs
cards.subtitle: St. Mary Hall
cards.notes: Use the hall’s 24-hour computer labs for computer-based coursework, then follow residence-hall access expectations for the building.
cards.short_summary: A residence-hall study resource with 24-hour computer labs.
cards.evidence_claim: St. Kate’s campus preview states that St. Mary Hall includes 24-hour computer labs and shared lounges.
cards.access_notes: The university describes the computer labs as 24-hour; building access may be limited to residents or those with authorized campus access.

cards.title: Student Organization Center
cards.subtitle: Coeur de Catherine
cards.notes: Use the available computers for recognized club work, workshops, presentations, or other organization business with your student group.
cards.short_summary: A Coeur de Catherine work space equipped for student-club business and projects.
cards.evidence_claim: The Student Organization Center is available to student clubs and organizations for business and work, with computers and space for meetings, workshops, and presentations.
cards.source_title: Coeur de Catherine | St. Catherine University
cards.access_notes: Intended for student clubs and organizations conducting group-related business or programming.
